plan.name: Give OpenSCAD runtime errors file and line
plan.summary: Teach parseScadErrors to extract the file and numeric line from ERROR: messages ending in ' in file <file>, line <n>', optionally followed by a period, removing that suffix from message and preserving raw. Keep both parser-error shapes and their precedence, other ERROR: messages, the unparseable-output fallback, and parseScadWarnings unchanged. The existing repair message and error panel will then include their Line N: prefix for runtime failures. Extend the existing error-parser tests to cover runtime locations and the behavior being preserved.

tests.name: Assertion errors retain their file and line
tests.says: An assertion error ending in a file and line without a period yields the message, file, numeric line and unchanged raw output.
tests.selector: OpenSCAD runtime error locations attributes an assertion without a final period

tests.name: Recursion errors accept a final period
tests.says: A recursion error with an absolute file path and a period after its line number yields the message without the location suffix, the file, numeric line and unchanged raw output.
tests.selector: OpenSCAD runtime error locations attributes recursion with a final period

tests.name: Runtime locations preserve other diagnostics
tests.says: An arbitrary runtime error is attributed in an ordered mixture of diagnostics while both parser-error forms retain precedence, nonmatching ERROR: lines stay generic, and warnings and fallback results remain unchanged.
tests.selector: OpenSCAD runtime error locations preserves existing diagnostics alongside runtime locations
